scope: Full next read API card, not whole roadmap
task_reconstruction: Make accepted local Bank material reusable via closed typed read requests and bounded protected originals; existing DB only, R1 four types, no search/UI/real user content/release

real_problems.requirement: Bounded query/output work and strict exchange
real_problems.finding: Card did not select preparse limits, closed result schema or total per-request verification budget
real_problems.scenario: Oversized or deeply nested unknown JSON reaches parser; a page may verify large unrelated commits or output excessive material
real_problems.impact: Unbounded resource use or undefined result exchange
real_problems.resolution: 16384-byte/depth16 requests,4MiB output,64MiB metadata/264MiB total stored bytes,256 members,30sec/2M SQLite VM budget; targeted bounded integrity and result schema

real_problems.finding: Lifetime of protection after one-shot CLI exit not defined
real_problems.scenario: Returning path could be mistaken for perpetual locked immutable file after process closes handles
real_problems.impact: Later consumers may trust changed exported bytes
real_problems.resolution: Protection during API context, private persistent export after CLI, later consumer compares reported SHA/length; no eternal-lock claim

real_problems.requirement: Original accepted receipt and latest attempt separately
real_problems.finding: Current importer has attempt_receipts table but never records failed attempts; card did not choose availability representation
real_problems.scenario: Caller asks receipt.get after failed retry and expects a latest attempt that was never persisted
real_problems.resolution: Explicit not_recorded_by_current_writer and no unindexed table scan; preserve original accepted result

what_passed: Existing immutable accepted revisions and indexed history permit stable logical sequence pagination
Importer exposes protected readonly connection/integrity primitives; no DDL/protocol change needed
All three prior user scope answers available; no new user question required

deferred_items.why_not_now: Separate write path and lifecycle; current readonly scope cannot populate it
deferred_items.consequence: Retain explicit unavailability until writer adds trustworthy bounded lookup

deferred_items.item: Owned export cleanup and later revalidation endpoint
deferred_items.why_not_now: Current export lifecycle documented; automatic cleanup not authorized
deferred_items.trigger: Installed service/export management or measured growth
deferred_items.goal: Original access without unbounded disposable disk use
deferred_items.consequence: Private disposable exports accumulate; clients must continue verifying later reads
Read component alone cannot establish finished application

questions.question: How to access protected importer integrity reads in one consistent read transaction without exposing write capability?
questions.proposal: A reviewed read adapter using existing verified metadata/BLOB primitives; preserve immutable writer and fixed DDL. Select bounded connection lifetime and failure semantics before coding.

questions.question: How to represent large verified originals and latest diagnostic attempts?
questions.proposal: Generate protected owned output handles with explicit lifecycle and plain metadata; if no durable attempt log exists, declare latest diagnostic unavailable rather than inventing it. Record any remaining contract gap in the review.

limits_of_review: Source/card inspection and independent SQLite reasoning; implementation/native evidence pending
Trusted operator configuration/current owner/root parents; no hostile same-owner/admin resistance
